verdict.rationale: Stripe Identity processes sensitive user data (ID images, selfies, extracted document data), so a training opt-out or data-use control is a fair question for this kind of product. However, nothing in the evidence pack covers whether that data is used to train AI models or whether users can opt out. The pack covers verification flows, result access, review tools, sandboxes and the MCP server, none of which address training data use, and a general community worry about data security is not evidence of a training control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
